method: Every file scanned page by page (sha256 recomputed = inventory). Born-digital text PDFs: statement pages read through the text layer and the FY2025 income statement and cash flow were additionally rendered and compared with the text (identical). dimension_2_document_completeness.verdict: All 20 statement documents (14 interims + 6 annuals incl. 2 duplicate pairs) are YANSAB (company name on every cover), standalone, period matches the cover after correcting labels. 14 further files are earnings decks (3-12 pages) and 1 is the FY2025 Board report (62 pages): none contain statements, confirmed by page titles. Duplicates: d37eba16 = 0bd45a56 (FY2024, identical text hash c31c1f5fb3, different bytes) and fac312f6 = 7846fe50 (FY2023, identical text hash 9b28338ea5).
dimension_2_document_completeness.label_defects: Collector label = publication year for SE statement PDFs: 8a16842a '2023|FY' is FY2022; 7846fe50 '2024|FY' is FY2023 (and fac312f6 '2023|FY' is the same FY2023, so label 2023|FY holds two different years); 0bd45a56 '2025|FY' is FY2024; 02f11362 '2026|FY' is FY2025. The Board report e652467d and decks are labelled with the fiscal year, so label semantics are source-dependent.

dimension_3_company_coverage.verdict: Collected true periods: Q1 2022 through H1 2026 for every Q1/H1/9M, and FY2022, FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 (statements) - 18 of 18 periods in that window, each from a financial-statement file. Nothing before 2022 was collected (inventory's 46 'absent' periods are 2010-2021).
dimension_3_company_coverage.inventory_correction: Inventory counts 15 complete periods; page evidence gives 18 periods with statements (FY2022 mislabelled 2023, FY2025 counted 'extra'). Pre-2022 history not collected.
